questions.prompt: GTA 6 is out today — the reviews landed yesterday and after years of waiting, it's finally here. Which scene sounds most like yours tonight?

options.text: Buzzing — refreshing reviews, checking scores, the wait is over and my brain won't sit still.
Diving straight in tonight — launch day is the whole point, I'm playing.
Playing it steady — I'll get to it when the evening allows, no rush.
Letting the dust settle — everyone else can rush in, I'll stroll in when it's quiet.

questions.prompt: World of Warcraft just broke a 15-year-old record — a world that's been running longer than some players have been alive just made history again. When a record like that falls, where are you tonight?

options.text: Jumping back in — a record like that pulls me straight back into the world.
Tipping my hat to the grind — fifteen years of players built that moment.
Sharing it with friends — the record is fun, the group chat is better.
Watching from the outside — that world was mine once, but I've moved on.

questions.prompt: It's launch day — GTA 6 is out, your evening is free, and everyone's either playing, watching, or waiting their turn. The game is right there. Tonight, which way are you leaning?

options.text: Straight in — the new world is open and I'm not waiting another night.
Watching first — I'll see how the first players find it before I jump in.
Torn — my backlog is already a mountain and this just added a whole city.
Sticking with what I know — the new world can wait for me.

questions.prompt: The CMA Awards winners are in — it's an awards-night kind of evening, the kind where the show runs long and the couch is the best seat. If someone handled tonight's awards-night spread for you, what would you want in front of you?

options.text: A big buttery popcorn bowl — the full awards-night spread, no shortcuts.
Something warm and slow — tea or cocoa to sip through the show.
Snacks to share — half the fun is passing the bowl around.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Taylor Swift is back at the CMAs after 13 years — a stage she left a long time ago is welcoming her home last night. What does a return like that sound like to you?

options.text: The comeback anthem loud — thirteen years away deserves a big sound.
The old favorites, easy — the songs I already know by heart.
My own lofi underneath — the return can wait, I'm keeping it calm.
Quiet — the homecoming is loud enough out there, I want stillness in here.

questions.prompt: The Glastonbury 2027 headliners just dropped — Harry Styles, Billie Eilish, Cher — and suddenly next summer has a soundtrack. In the hour ahead, what does your evening feel like?

options.text: Mapping the summer with friends — which day, which stage, who's coming.
A slow daydream — picturing the field, the music, the long light.
A quiet wind-down — the lineup can wait, one cozy thing done properly.
A full stop — the day is done, I'm switching off entirely.
